prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ORIGINAL promotional concept artwork for BARE, a grounded multiplayer planetary survival game with industrial space travel. This must look like BARE's own world, not a Rust screenshot or a depiction of Rust characters.

Input image is a DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY for our original Tin Finch utility spacecraft. Reproduce its distinctive boxy pale blue-gray chipped sheet-metal cockpit, large flat windows, orange-brown corrosion, round external cylinders, landing skids and compact scale in the background.

Scene: After a successful ambush, two original armed adult frontier survivors collect another survivor's dropped gear on a rocky alien highland. One survivor kneels, visibly moving magazines and a compact mechanical component from an open rugged backpack into a canvas satchel. The other stands watch with a practical worn rifle held ready across the chest, looking outward. A second rifle, ammunition, tool kit and small metal cargo case are clearly visible with the loot. Nobody is running. No dead body, gore or battle scene.

Original character design: a believable mix of rough everyday survival equipment and repurposed industrial spaceflight gear. Kneeling survivor wears a weathered slate-gray padded mechanic jacket with tan canvas sleeves, asymmetrical off-white riveted protective plates salvaged from spacecraft panels, scratched knee pads and heavy work boots. A compact battered open-face utility helmet, fabric neck scarf and visible human face, ordinary work gloves. Standing survivor wears a faded brown field jacket, worn charcoal cargo trousers, a patched pale blue utility chest harness with small mechanical fittings, and a simple battered industrial half-helmet with raised protective visor, visible face. Modest equipment, human proportions, practical silhouettes, no superhero armor. These are new Bare characters, not any existing game's costumes.

Background: the referenced Tin Finch parked behind them at far right, a SMALL player-built stone and corrugated-metal shelter near it, unfamiliar craggy mountains, sparse conifers, a distant large moon, cold evening mist and warm amber horizon. No famous landmarks from another game. The simple shelter is handmade and modular, not a factory or research installation.

Composition is crucial for the existing website: cinematic landscape 16:9, target 1672x941. Keep BOTH entire characters, their helmets, all weapons, hands and foreground loot wholly in the RIGHT 44% (x=56%-96%, y=28%-88%). The kneeling survivor is at x=68%; the lookout is at x=86%. The Tin Finch and shelter remain in the right background. Leave the LEFT 50% as naturally dark, quiet rocky foreground and atmospheric mountain silhouettes where HTML text will later overlay; no important subject there. Keep everything inside the frame, no cropped feet or weapons. One seamless immersive landscape with no blank rectangle or split-panel design.

Style: cinematic realistic high-quality game concept illustration, tactile fabric, scuffed metal, believable hand anatomy and weapons, cool graphite/slate with warm practical highlights; match the ship's workhorse industrial character. No yellow hazmat suits, no red hoods, no blue rubber gloves, no road-sign armor, no perforated Rust metal face masks, no recognizable Rust outfits, no Rust landmarks, no sleek white astronaut suits, no military sci-fi franchise armor, no laser swords. No text, UI, logos, watermark or typography.
supersedes: The v8 loot-ambush variant was rejected for looking directly like Rust. It is excluded from the published assets.
